## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#98`
- **Variant Name**: `WithdrawDuplicateStreamIds`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::WithdrawManyDuplicateIds` — the same stream id appears more than once in the batch.

---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Deduplicate stream ids before calling `withdraw_many`; each id may appear only once in the batch.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/CLAIM_ALL.md#1-overview--entrypoint-specification`](../../docs/CLAIM_ALL.md#1-overview--entrypoint-specification)
